title: KimiyayeVahshDeckCard
description: Phase 01 data schema for a single card in کیمیای وحش. No art/UI/engine fields required.

id.description: Stable slug, unique across the whole deck.

nameEn.description: Normalized English display name. Prefer englishName when both exist; nameEn is kept for compatibility.

originalName.description: Exact spelling as it appeared in the source list file, including typos.

assetFilenameOriginal.description: Exact asset filename spelling when it differs from the creature id/name.

assetFilenameRankHint.description: Numeric prefix parsed from an asset filename, if any. Does not override Base List ranks.

originalRank.description: Rank exactly as recorded in the authoritative source (e.g. "A", "B", "C", or "1"–"10"). Not auto-mapped.

displayRank.description: What is printed on the card. For face ranks, currently mirrors originalRank (A/B/C).

numericPower.description: Comparable numeric power when assigned. For A/B/C face ranks this stays null until a later mapping decision. For ranks 1–10 it equals the integer rank.

mythic.description: Legacy boolean aligned with type===legendary when classification is known; null when status is needs-review.

mythicForm.description: Deprecated for Dragon of Moses. Those are three independent legendary cards, not multi-form variants. Field may remain null for compatibility.

dataStatus.description: How trustworthy this card row is for later phases.

assetRef.description: Relative path to an existing source image under the parent project folder, if any. Phase 01 stores reference only.

type.description: Creature class for the soft 10-normal + 3-legendary design target. Null when status is needs-review.

status.description: Review flag. Use needs-review when legendary/normal classification is uncertain. Do not guess.
